title: Salt Lake City Scavenger Hunt Walking Tour and Game
includes: Access to the interactive scavenger hunt and challenges you follow & find with your smartphone.
Fully charged smartphone with Internet connection (not included)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Wear comfortable shoes! You'll walk about 2 miles along this scavenger hunt activity.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Embark on an engaging scavenger hunt through the historic streets of Salt Lake City, the historic heart of the great western state of Utah. Explore State Street and the Utah State Capitol Grounds. Stroll Main St, where the modern and historic come together. See the historic sights like the Old City Hall, Great Salt Lake Base and Meridian, Eagle Gate, and much more.

Explore and see the many unique shops, restaurants and galleries. Go at your own pace and see the best of what Salt Lake City has to offer. Ready to discover Salt Lake City in a whole new way? Let the adventure begin!
